subject: Post-signature staged rollout: evaluation gates, canary cadence & training windows
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Susan Park <susan@elysian.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-signature staged rollout: evaluation gates, canary cadence & training windows

Hi Susan —

Thanks again for signing. Per our kickoff call, attached is the staged execution plan we propose to embed inside the MAP. High-level ask: please confirm the evaluation window and the pilot users (10-15 clinician accounts) by EOD Monday so we can reserve the canary pool for the week of 6/22.

Key points in this draft:
- Week 0 (preflight): config handoff, SOC evidence exchange, test tokens provisioned.
- Week 1 (canary): 10 pilot users, 1x dedicated canary GPU pool, daily smoke evaluations (latency, model drift).
- Week 2–3 (ramped rollout): staged 20% -> 50% -> 100% traffic shifts with rollback gates at each step.
- Training: two live sessions (admin + clinician) scheduled in Week 1 and Week 3; recorded material available.
- Eval gates: perf thresholds (p95 latency < 350ms), quality benchmarks (F1 on 5 canonical prompts), and error budget thresholds.

Attachments included: ELY-MAP-v1.2.xlsx (mutual action timeline with owners), canary-checklist-v3.pdf (ops runbook), training-curriculum-week1.docx.

If this aligns, Ben will draft the DocuSign addendum for the dedicated canary capacity, and Laura will schedule the two training sessions.

Thanks,
Olga

--
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Susan Park <susan@elysian.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Elysian Procurement <procurement@elysian.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-signature staged rollout: evaluation gates, canary cadence & training windows

Hi Olga —

Appreciate the clear plan. A few clarifications from our side before we lock dates:

1) Pilot users: we can provide 12 clinician accounts. We need two API keys scoped to test and staging; can you confirm token TTL and IP allowlist process?
2) Training: Week 1 live session okay, but clinician session must be on a Wednesday afternoon (PST) or Thursday morning. Week 3 is flexible.
3) Eval gates: can you add an acceptance criterion for semantic regression — we’ll provide a 40-prompt test set (baseline responses included). Please confirm how Redwood will report regression alerts (Slack + email).

Procurement note: we need the dedicated canary pricing line item clarified (monthly vs one-off). Procurement will hold off on countersign until the DocuSign shows the canary SKU.

Thanks — Susan

Susan Park
Head of Product, Elysian HealthTech
susan@elysian.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Elysian Procurement <procurement@elysian.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-signature staged rollout: evaluation gates, canary cadence & training windows

Hi Susan —

Quick answers:
- Token TTL / allowlist: test keys will have a 30-day TTL by default; we can set a shorter TTL if you prefer. IP allowlist is handled via the private networking tab in the Console — we’ll send the instructions.
- Regression alerts: Redwood will create a dedicated Slack channel (we recommend #elysian-canary). Alerts: perf threshold breaches and semantic regression flags will post there and trigger an email to the ops distribution. We’ll include links to the failing prompts and the diff against baseline.
- Canary SKU: Olga and I updated the quote; DocuSign line item will read: "Dedicated Canary Pool — 1x T4s-equivalent slot — 30 days (trial)" as a one-off credit line with an option to convert to monthly reserved capacity.

Olga — I attached the updated ELY-MAP-v1.2 with small edits: added token TTL, named Slack channel, and explicit rollback criteria (manual rollback + auto-fallback to last stable model if F1 drops > 10%). Laura and I assigned owners for training and smoke-run checklists. Can you confirm the clinician session preference so Laura can lock a slot?

Thanks,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Hi all —

Locking in dates per Susan’s preference: clinician session scheduled Wednesday 2026-06-23 at 14:30 PST (60m). Admin session scheduled Monday 2026-06-21 at 11:00 PST (45m).

Action items:
- Susan / Elysian: send the 40-prompt test set by Friday 6/11 so we can bake it into the automated regression checks.
- Olga: please confirm DocuSign readiness once Ben’s line item is added.
- Ben: please publish the canary Slack channel and invite Elysian ops leads (we’ll include read-only links for product oncall).

I’ve also attached the canary-checklist-v3.pdf and training-curriculum-week1.docx here for quick reference. If the procurement team needs a separate SOW excerpt for the canary trial, let me know and I’ll draft a short addendum.

Thanks and looking forward to the pilot — small, measurable steps and fast feedback loops.

Best,
